El Enviado (The Envoy) is a video game created for the PSVita Contest ReiHEN. In this game you play as an angel who works at a temporary-employment agency, trying to prevent the suicide of a young man who wants to jump from a high-rise apartment.
Try to connect with him through dialogue — will you be able to save him without dying in the attempt?

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
